title: Midjourneyで子どもたちの画像をdraftモードで生成し、スクリーンショットを撮ってカタログ化すると楽に素材整理できる
content:
Midjourneyで子どもたちの画像をdraftモードで生成し、スクリーンショットを撮ってカタログ化すると楽に素材整理できる  
Midjourneyで--sref randomを使ってdraft生成すると異なる画風の案が一度に出てきておすすめ  
アドリブな落書きと画像2枚をGPTに渡して解釈させ、その解釈を元にSeedanceで動画化する

en.content:
Generating images of children in draft mode with Midjourney and taking screenshots for cataloging makes organizing materials easy.  
Using --sref random in Midjourney for draft generation brings up different styles at once, which is recommended.  
Pass two ad-lib sketches and images to GPT for interpretation, and then use that interpretation to create a video with Seedance.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] The attached two images were generated with Midjourney. By generating images of children in draft mode and taking screenshots, you can easily catalog them.  
Using --sref random for drafting brings up different styles at once, which is interesting and recommended. https://t.co/JQOwjTEaT6
---
